description: A one rep max calculator that shows the training percentages too, not just the number. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

formula.description: Which published regression to use for the headline figure. Epley is the usual default and what most lifting apps show; every formula's answer comes back in `estimates` regardless.

reps.description: How many reps were completed with that weight, 1 to 20. One rep returns the weight itself rather than a formula's estimate of it. Above ten the estimate is reported with `reliable: false`.

weight.description: The weight lifted, in kilograms or pounds — the unit is never converted, so every number that comes back is in the same one you sent.

name: one_rep_max
title: One Rep Max Calculator
